detail.longDescription: A “first-person view” drone "often looks like something assembled at a workbench. Its frame may be commercially available carbon fiber. Its motors, flight controller, radio, camera and batteries may come from civilian supply chains. Wiring is exposed. Antennas protrude from the body. The payload may be an adapted grenade, a shaped charge removed from another weapon or a purpose-built munition attached underneath.
